# Organization & Priority Checklist: 003-task-organization-priority

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for HU-07 (priority), HU-08 (categories), HU-09 (overdue) and integrated query — with emphasis on data-integrity requirements
**Created**: 2026-10-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are default-priority requirements specified for all task creation paths when no explicit priority is provided? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 - Are category creation validation requirements (mandatory name, 50-char limit, non-blank, optional description) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK003 - Are safe-unlink requirements specified such that category deletion preserves tasks via SET NULL and never cascades? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 - Are audit-log requirements specified for all four mutation types with mandatory fields (actor_id, action, entity_id, timestamp)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-021]
- [ ] CHK005 - Are filtering requirements specified for both a specific category and the special "sin categoría" condition? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 - Is the default value "media" quantified as the explicit stored value `medium` rather than an absent or null state? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 - Are category name uniqueness requirements clarified with normalization rules (strip, case-insensitive per user)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK008 - Is the secondary tie-break ordering for equal priorities specified with a deterministic criterion? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the overdue reference defined as strictly-earlier-than server calendar date in UTC (`due_date < current_date`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 - Are priority value definitions (`high` / `medium` / `low`) consistent between spec, data-model, and task contracts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Detailed-1]
- [ ] CHK011 - Are category ownership requirements consistent across listing, assignment, and deletion (owner-only scope)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-012, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK012 - Are overdue exclusion rules consistent for completed, logically deleted, and dateless tasks (all resolve `is_overdue = false`)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-017, Spec §FR-018, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK013 - Are sort-direction semantics consistent (desc = Alta > Media > Baja) across functional requirements, contracts, and assumptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Assumption]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 - Can the ordering success criterion be objectively measured (deterministic order, < 1s for 500 tasks)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK015 - Are zero-loss acceptance criteria for category deletion specified in measurable terms (100% tasks preserved with `category_id = null`)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK016 - Can the zero-inconsistency criterion for server-side overdue calculation be objectively verified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK017 - Are combined filter-plus-sort requirements specified for the triple combination (status + category + priority order)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, Spec §US-4]
- [ ] CHK018 - Are alternate-flow requirements specified for removing a category from a task (transition to "sin categoría")? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK019 - Are exception-flow requirements specified for invalid priority values with a descriptive validation message? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK020 - Are exception-flow requirements specified for foreign-category assignment attempts (IDOR rejection)? [Coverage, Exception Flow, Spec §FR-012]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 - Are requirements addressed for concurrent category deletion during an in-flight task assignment? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 - Are requirements addressed prohibiting priority/category mutation and overdue flagging on logically deleted tasks? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-017]
- [ ] CHK023 - Are boundary requirements specified for `due_date == today` resolving as not overdue? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-017, Assumption]
- [ ] CHK024 - Are requirements addressed for homonymous category names across different users (uniqueness scoped per `user_id`)? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK025 - Are performance requirements specified for priority ordering and category operations (thresholds, data volumes)? [NFR, Plan §Technical Context, Gap]
- [ ] CHK026 - Does the spec define that overdue and priority indicators are supplied resolved by the backend with no date logic delegated to JavaScript? [NFR, Spec §FR-020]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 - Is the assumption that Increments 1 and 2 are fully functional documented and validated as a precondition? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 - Are out-of-scope boundaries explicitly defined (HU-10, HU-11, HU-15, HU-16, multi-tag, shared categories)? [Traceability, Spec §Exclusiones]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK029 - Is the Spanish/English priority mapping (Alta/high, Media/medium, Baja/low) specified without ambiguity for contracts and presentation? [Ambiguity, Spec §Assumptions, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK030 - Is "fecha actual del servidor" specified with timezone authority and date-vs-datetime granularity for the overdue comparison? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-017]
